title: Context, Credibility, and Control: User Reflections on AI-Assisted Misinformation Tools

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a collaborative AI prototype featuring a debate-style interaction mode to measure its effectiveness in prompting counter-arguments and mitigating users' confirmation bias through user surveys and Likert-scale ratings.

Categorizing supporting news sources by their ideological perspectives (left-leaning, centrist, right-leaning) and collecting quantitative and qualitative user feedback on the usefulness of providing these bias transparency tags to users.
